**Synopsis:**
Climate scientist Michael Mann argues that the Nepal/Tibet glacial collapse — killing 900+ and leaving 4,400+ missing — is a direct, causally unambiguous consequence of human-induced warming. He frames it as the culmination of a 2022 "summer of extremes" encompassing US/European heat domes, wildfires in France/Spain/Canada, and a Midwest derecho. He distinguishes direct causal events (glacial collapse) from statistical attribution science, while asserting both support climate change linkage. The piece closes with a political call-to-action targeting US midterm voters and criticises Trump-era fossil fuel policies.
